run_BlenderBot3Agent_batch_act: run the BlenderBot3Agent batch_act method to process a batch of dialogue observations through the full OPT BB3 pipeline
run_BlenderBot3Agent_batch_act_dialogue: run the batch_act_dialogue method to generate dialogue replies with knowledge conditioning from search memory or contextual sources
run_BlenderBot3Agent_batch_act_knowledge: run the batch_act_knowledge method to retrieve and inject search results or memories into knowledge module prompts
run_BlenderBot3Agent_get_search_results: run the get_search_results method to retrieve search documents from the search agent for a batch of generated queries
run_BlenderBot3Agent_batch_act_decision: run the batch_act_decision method to determine which examples should use search or memory retrieval and handle API failures
